gates.description: Stable identity, units, axes, scale, and version are independently reconstructable.
Required named parts, hierarchy, sockets, pivots, and variants are present.
Geometry is finite, bounded, nondegenerate, and matches the declared silhouette and dimensions.
Topology supports the declared deformation, editing, baking, and runtime requirements.
UV sets, coverage, seams, density, and overlap policy satisfy the profile.
Material slots and PBR channels survive the declared interchange and engine path.
Skeleton, joint hierarchy, bind pose, skin weights, and retarget basis are valid.
Required clips, contacts, root policy, event anchors, and interaction alignment are valid.
Colliders, mass regions, triggers, navigation, and moving-part clearances are valid.
LOD, impostor, streaming, and fallback products preserve silhouette and behavior.
The exact product imports into the declared engine without unwaived errors.
Measured draw, memory, CPU, GPU, load, and storage budgets pass on the target.
Named parts, interactions, damage zones, sockets, and state transitions match external game law.
The asset belongs to the declared family across palette, shape language, materials, and scale.
Silhouette, affordances, telegraphs, weak points, and interaction anchors read at play distance.
Parsers, archives, scripts, shaders, and embedded data pass bounded hostile-input checks.
Inputs, model/tool versions, transformations, authorship, and output hashes are retained.
Source, model, dataset, output, redistribution, credit, and territory terms satisfy policy.
Artist edits round-trip without destroying identity, behavior anchors, or supplier independence.
A second provider or neutral fallback can satisfy the same capability contract.
Version upgrade, deprecation, rollback, and reconstruction procedures are explicit.
A named human authority accepted the asset in the real product venue.

capabilities.description: Express gameplay, art, budget, provenance, and fallback requirements without naming a supplier.
Normalize images, turnarounds, masks, dimensions, and rights metadata.
Generate base geometry from bounded references or procedural recipes.
Generate or recover named semantic parts under an application-owned part schema.
Generate deterministic editable source programs that compile into assets.
Produce edit- and deformation-suitable topology from a geometry candidate.
Produce UV sets under density, seam, overlap, and channel policies.
Produce lighting-independent PBR texture channels under a material profile.
Translate material intent through MaterialX/OpenPBR and engine profiles.
Create skeleton, bind pose, skin weights, constraints, and retarget metadata.
Generate or retarget motion candidates without defining combat timing.
Generate bounded colliders, triggers, mass regions, and navigation proxies.
Generate LODs, impostors, streaming groups, and source-preserving fallbacks.
Optimize a glTF delivery product while preserving declared semantics.
Compress texture products into portable GPU-ready KTX2/Basis forms.
Compose variants, layers, references, and assemblies without destructive flattening.
Resolve stable entity references to versions and platform products without path coupling.
Package constrained portable behavior hints without acquiring game-law authority.
Run format and profile conformance without supplier runtime.
Import and exercise exact asset products in engine fixtures.
Evaluate silhouette, materials, style family, telegraphs, and play-distance readability.
Bind source, tools, models, transforms, licenses, credits, and product hashes.
Scan archives, parsers, scripts, shaders, and embedded resources under resource bounds.
Publish canonical source, engine variants, receipts, credits, and fallback as one product.
Compare suppliers on a frozen corpus without promoting a winner outside the measured cell.
Round-trip asset corrections while retaining semantic and provenance continuity.

gaps.firstExperiment: Compile the UNDERDRAIN valve intent into one glTF and one Unity prefab while preserving named parts, pivots, sockets, and interaction anchors.
gaps.failureDefault: Keep the generated object at design-reference or candidate tier.

gaps.firstExperiment: Generate five mechanism assets from one style packet and compare palette, shape language, scale, texel density, and material response in one sewer scene.
gaps.failureDefault: Reject family promotion even when individual assets look acceptable.

gaps.firstExperiment: Measure mechanism affordance and enemy weak-point recognition at the production camera distance under sewer lighting.
gaps.failureDefault: Hold the asset for redesign; studio renders do not count.

gaps.firstExperiment: Compare PartCrafter, CubePart, and manual Blender segmentation against the same valve and boss-toad part schema.
gaps.failureDefault: Preserve the monolithic candidate but forbid behavior binding.

gaps.firstExperiment: Retopologize one hero head and one toad limb through multiple suppliers and run the same deformation corpus.
gaps.failureDefault: No rig or animation promotion.

gaps.firstExperiment: Compare SkinTokens, UniRig, and a Rigify correction path on hopper, shield brute, boss toad, and plumber.
gaps.failureDefault: Retain only static or manually rigged variants.

gaps.firstExperiment: Retarget generated locomotion and mechanism clips against authored contact frames, weapon arcs, cancel windows, and root policy.
gaps.failureDefault: Treat motion as reference only.

gaps.firstExperiment: Assemble a complete pump-room kit from independent providers and measure scale, snapping, seam, material, and lighting continuity.
gaps.failureDefault: Do not publish a modular kit.

gaps.firstExperiment: Round-trip source through Blender, USD, glTF, Unity, and back while preserving identities, materials, clips, sockets, and variants.
gaps.failureDefault: Declare the path lossy and retain the canonical source separately.

gaps.firstExperiment: Measure draw calls, texture residency, skinning, animation, colliders, load time, and frame cost on 4060 desktop and Quest profile.
gaps.failureDefault: No engine-qualified status.

gaps.firstExperiment: Create a provider-by-provider legal packet covering model, weights, training-data terms, output rights, territory, credit, and redistribution.
gaps.failureDefault: legal_review or research_only; no shipping product.

gaps.firstExperiment: Bind one asset through SPDX 3, C2PA, in-toto, USD metadata, glTF extras, and engine package receipts without identity drift.
gaps.failureDefault: Retain the AXM sidecar as the authority-neutral custody record.

gaps.firstExperiment: Build malformed GLB, USD, texture, archive, shader, and behavior-graph fixtures with parser, memory, path, and decompression limits.
gaps.failureDefault: Sandbox and refuse untrusted products.

gaps.firstExperiment: Record an artist correction as a semantic delta and prove supplier replacement can reapply or consciously supersede it.
gaps.failureDefault: The corrected asset becomes a new lineage branch, never a silent overwrite.

gaps.firstExperiment: Represent a valve, door, and weak-point reaction in KHR_interactivity while keeping Arc or host game law external.
gaps.failureDefault: Store behavior anchors only; host owns behavior.

gaps.firstExperiment: Expose accepted products through OpenAssetIO entity references and resolve engine-specific variants without filesystem assumptions.
gaps.failureDefault: Use content-addressed local references with explicit version pinning.

gaps.firstExperiment: Map HY3D-Bench, 3DCodeBench, Anymate, Nova3D-Bench, and engine fixtures into one cell-compatible report model.
gaps.failureDefault: Keep external benchmark claims separate from local acceptance.

gaps.firstExperiment: Run every adapter without network, shell expansion, writable source tree, or unbounded subprocesses and retain exact environment receipts.
gaps.failureDefault: Provider remains disabled.

gaps.firstExperiment: Publish small CC0 fixtures for valve, root gate, modular wall kit, hero, hopper, and boss toad with hidden engine checks.
gaps.failureDefault: No ecosystem-wide compatibility claim.

gaps.firstExperiment: Package canonical source, USD composition, glTF delivery, Unity/Godot variants, credits, and receipts behind one entity identity.
gaps.failureDefault: Publish engine-specific packages as separate variants with no equivalence claim.
